notes: You can now speak a record instead of typing it — in Arabic, English or both. Tap the mic on a new record, use the new Speak shortcut or widget button, or tap the mic in Penny to ask her a question out loud.
Voice uses your Gemini key. Peace asks for the microphone the first time you tap it, listens only while the mic is open, and never keeps the recording.
Peace now opens in your theme: light for Paper and Mist, dark for Ledger and Graphite, instead of always dark. On Android 12 and later, a new theme shows from the next time you open the app.
The Analysis chart is bigger. Tap or hold any part of it to see which category it is and its share of the month.

Analysis now breaks each category down by its sub-categories, in the list and as an outer ring on the chart. Every category gets its own row too, instead of the smaller ones being folded into "Other".
Fixed a rare freeze when Peace opened while a Google Drive backup was due. If Peace ever stops responding again, About now lists when and what it was busy with, so you can share it with us.
The keypad's next key now shows where it goes: the account, then the category, then a check to save.
After an update, Peace now shows what changed — like this. Find it again any time in About.
Retaking setup with an AI key already saved now lets you continue past that step.
Setup now asks how Peace should look: match your phone, or pick Ledger, Graphite, Paper or Mist by seeing them.
Attach a PDF invoice or a text file to a record and Peace reads the amount from it, the same as a receipt photo.
Home-screen widgets: this month's budget, your balances, and a quick-add button.
The camera opens right inside the notes field. One press of the shutter attaches the receipt.
